categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the printed circuit board (PCB) manufacturing industry, focusing on high-end PCB products for enterprise communications, automotive electronics, industrial equipment, semiconductor chip testing, and consumer electronics. Key segments include enterprise communications market boards, automotive boards, industrial equipment boards, and consumer electronics boards.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced PCB manufacturing technologies including high-density interconnect (HDI) boards, multi-layer boards (especially 18 layers and above), embedded power chip packaging (P2Pack), laser drilling with high precision, and materials optimized for high-speed signal transmission and reliability. It emphasizes continuous process innovation, automation, intelligent manufacturing, and green production methods.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are in the enterprise communications sector (including AI servers, HPC, and high-speed network equipment), automotive electronics (electric vehicles, ADAS, smart cockpit, and vehicle networking), industrial control, semiconductor testing, and consumer electronics. The company serves global markets with a focus on high-end applications requiring advanced PCB solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Kunshan, Huangshi, Changzhou, and Thailand, and has commercial subsidiaries in Hong Kong and Singapore. It serves customers worldwide, with significant export sales primarily to the Asia-Pacific region, Americas, Europe, and Japan. The company is expanding overseas production capacity, notably in Thailand, to diversify supply chain risks.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the electronics supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and sales of PCBs and related electronic components. It also engages in supply chain management and some real estate development through subsidiaries but is mainly a PCB manufacturer supplying to downstream electronics manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include focusing on high-end PCB products for AI, high-speed networking, and automotive electronics, with continuous R&D investment in advanced materials, high-density interconnect technology, embedded chip packaging, and precision manufacturing. The company aims to enhance production efficiency through automation and intelligent manufacturing, expand capacity especially for AI chip supporting PCBs, and pursue green manufacturing and sustainable development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of various types of PCBs, including enterprise communications boards, automotive boards, and industrial boards. Additional revenue streams include sales of materials, property sales, and property management services. The company also earns income from investment dividends and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading brand in the PCB industry in China and globally recognized among the top PCB manufacturers. It competes with other major PCB producers in China, Taiwan, Japan, Korea, and Southeast Asia. Its competitive advantages lie in technology leadership, product quality, diversified customer base, and strategic overseas production expansion to mitigate geopolitical and trade risks.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 13.34 billion, a 49.26% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 2.59 billion, up 71.05%. Total assets reached RMB 21.18 billion, growing 32.08% from the previous year. The company has shown strong growth driven by expanded production scale, product mix optimization, and increased demand in AI and automotive sectors.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, technologically advanced PCB products tailored for high-end applications such as AI servers, high-speed networking, and automotive electronics. It differentiates through superior technical capabilities, rapid response to customer needs, flexible production capacity, and sustainable green manufacturing practices. Its integrated R&D and manufacturing capabilities enable it to meet complex customer requirements with high reliability and competitive cost.
